about: ONE answer for both languages: the mint-stamp key of each withhold scope. The browser door stamps heldWithholds.js::heldWithholdKey(w) on a minted document (meta.heldWithholds); the server reads it with api/services/held_withholds.py::withhold_key(w). tests/test_pine_held_withholds_saved_copies.py and app/src/components/chart/engine/heldWithholds.savedCopies.test.js both assert every row.
